subject: Paul J Donato Jr Candidate Profile
overview: Candidate Paul J. Donato Jr. presented his platform for the Medford City Council, outlining proposals for public safety, affordable housing, river transportation, and zoning.

items.title: Introduction and Charter Committee
items.summary: Candidate Paul J. Donato Jr. discussed entering the City Council race and argued that the Charter was created to protect the budget and serve the public.

items.title: Fire Department Proposal
items.summary: Donato proposed purchasing land on Mystic Ave to construct a world-class fire department.

items.title: Affordable Housing
items.summary: Donato proposed replacing the old police and fire station with affordable housing for veterans, seniors, and disabled residents.

items.title: Mystic River and Commuter Boat
items.summary: Donato proposed cleaning up the Mystic River and partnering with the MBTA to launch a commuter boat service to Boston.

items.title: Zoning and Closing Remarks
items.summary: Donato advocated against residential rezoning to focus energy on revitalizing the squares and Mystic Ave.
